sites.name: Sparks Senior Center Congregate Meal

schedules.note: Washoe County Senior Services congregate lunch for ages 60+; reservation recommended (call center).

sites.note: Open and operating. The 2025 renovation was only a ~2-week flooring closure (Jun 30 - week of Jul 14, 2025); center has reopened. During that closure meals were served to-go at 11:30 AM in the parking lot. No current renovation closure. City of Sparks site now uses cityofsparks.us domain (old sparksnv.gov path still resolves).

sites.name: Fallon Daily Bread (Wolf Center)

schedules.note: Hot dinner, all welcome, no requirements. (Fallon Chamber lists 17:30-18:30; statewide Nevada Independent guide lists 17:00-18:00 — kept input/NevInd window.)

sites.note: Operating. Run via Epworth/Methodist church (epworthchurch.info). Phone corrected to 775-423-4714 (listed main line; input 775-423-2282 not confirmed). Dinner Mon/Thu confirmed by both Nevada Independent (5-6pm) and Fallon Chamber (5:30-6:30pm); added confirmed Mon food bank + Wed/Sat sack lunch distributions.
